Messages.Author: Rachel & Chris
Messages.Body:
To clarify:

Dodge negates the effects of a strike, even First Strikes, no matter what
they are- Damage, Steal Blood, Destroy Equipment, Send To Torpor- as long as
it's not Combat Ends, right?

Messages.Author: TheLa...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
In article <F2Bs5...@midway.uchicago.edu>,


No, it only negates the effects on your vampire or ally, if the strike
targets a retainer or piece of equipment, the strike still works.

Also, if the strike has any negative effect on the vampire or ally
making the strike (White Phosphorous Grenade, for example) the minion
using the strike will still take the appropriate damage.

Carpe Noctem.

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:
Rachel & Chris wrote:
>
> To clarify:
>
> Dodge negates the effects of a strike, even First Strikes, no matter what
> they are- Damage, Steal Blood, Destroy Equipment, Send To Torpor- as long as
> it's not Combat Ends, right?
>

Dodge cancels the effects of a strike on the dodging minion and any
non-retainer cards on him/her.

In particular, Dodge does not alter, affect, or change what happens as a
result of Strike: Combat Ends, Strike: Dodge, or a ranged attack at long
range that is assigning its damage to your retainer.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
TheLa...@hotmail.com wrote:
> "Rachel & Chris" <reei...@midway.uchicago.edu> wrote:

> > Dodge negates the effects of a strike, even First Strikes, no matter what
> > they are- Damage, Steal Blood, Destroy Equipment, Send To Torpor- as long as
> > it's not Combat Ends, right?
>

> No, it only negates the effects on your vampire or ally, if the strike
> targets a retainer or piece of equipment, the strike still works.

It negates the opposing strike's effects on the dodging minion and any
non-Retainer cards on the dodging minion.

Equipment is "protected" by a dodge.

> Also, if the strike has any negative effect on the vampire or ally
> making the strike (White Phosphorous Grenade, for example) the minion
> using the strike will still take the appropriate damage.

Correct - dodge protects only the dodging minion (and any non-Retainer
cards on him).
